data.name: Jeremiah
data.gender_notes: Jeremiah is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Hebrew Yirmeyahu, from a root meaning 'to exalt', + Yahu, 'Yahweh'. Its root is Hebrew r-w-m-y-h-w. The prophet Jeremiah; the Book of Jeremiah. Jeremiah is a Hebrew name meaning “Yahweh exalts”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Jeremiah expresses “Yahweh exalts”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Hebrew Yirmeyahu, from a root meaning 'to exalt', + Yahu, 'Yahweh'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jeremiah total 42, reducing to 6. Number 6 is associated with responsibility, care and harmony.
